_stamp: CB-T1 verification artifact for @zakkster/lite-signal-decorators COOKBOOK.md. Checked-in allowlist per PD-39: package -> { version, source, probed, symbols }. Every cross-package symbol cited by any recipe or POINTER block MUST appear here. Vendored into the repo so test/15-cookbook.test.mjs never reads outside the package directory. Facts resolved fail-closed on 2026-08-30 by source citation plus a runnable probe; nothing guessed. ASCII only.

_verdicts.a_lite_store_binds_helpers_and_registry: default-registry-only (PD-29 wall applies). Store.js:34 imports { signal, batch, dispose, isTracking, untrack } from @zakkster/lite-signal at module load; Store.js:141 calls signal(value) with NO registry argument; grep for 'registry' over Store.js returns zero matches. Top-level signal delegates to defaultRegistry.signal (lite-signal Signal.js:1904-1906, bound to `let defaultRegistry = createRegistry()` at :1898). Probe (scratchpad/probe-a.mjs): a default-registry effect reading a store key re-ran on every mutation (seen 1 -> 2 -> 3); a custom createRegistry() effect reading the same key ran once at init and NEVER re-ran (customSeen stuck at 1). Lazily-created per-key property signals land in the DEFAULT registry only. r6 inherits the PD-29 wall verbatim.
_verdicts.b_lite_store_signatures: Read from Store.d.ts. store(initial) / unwrap(s) / snapshot(s) / dispose(s) / reconcile(s, next, opts?) with opts.key?: string | ((item)=>unknown). See lite-store symbols below.
_verdicts.c_lite_arena_surface: Read from Arena.d.ts. arena.registerComponent(schema, options?) -> SparseSet; SparseSet exposes .data (parallel SoA TypedArrays), .dense (Int32Array of live handles), .count, .add/.remove/.has/.idx, and the worker round-trip pair .detach(keys?)/.rebind(buffers)/.isDetached. Spawn/kill are Arena.spawn():Entity and Arena.despawn(entity):boolean. See lite-arena symbols below.
_verdicts.d_lite_await_fromPromise_and_whenSignal: fromPromise(promise, initialData?) returns Signal<AsyncState<T>> where AsyncState is the three-state union { status:'pending'|'resolved'|'rejected', data, error }. The signal is created via `signal as _signal` imported top-level (Await.js:19, called at :998) -> lands in the DEFAULT registry (same PD-29 wall). whenSignal(source, predicate, opts?) exists and returns Promise<T>; resolves with the first satisfying value, cleans its effect on settle.
_verdicts.e_lite_signal_dom_keyed_peer_floor: CARD IS STALE; lite-signal 1.5.0 stable suffices. SignalDom.js:23 imports { effect, getOwner, runWithOwner } from @zakkster/lite-signal at module load; the source comment at SignalDom.js:629 states 'getOwner/runWithOwner require lite-signal >= 1.5.0'. Both are exported by the lite-signal 1.5.0 installed here: Signal.js exports getOwner (~:1947) and runWithOwner (~:1958). lite-signal-dom peerDependency is ^1.5.0-rc.1 (package.json:60), satisfied by 1.5.0 stable and by this package's 1.5.0 peer floor. The catalog card's 'runWithOwner only on rc dist-tag, latest still 1.4.x' is outdated. keyed() stays a POINTER in r4 only because it needs a DOM lane this package lacks, NOT because of an unmet peer.

symbols.name: store
symbols.note: Store.js:570 / Store.d.ts:18. Returns a Proxy typed as the initial value. Per-key value signals are allocated LAZILY on first tracked read (Store.js:284-285) in the DEFAULT registry; a plain read outside a reactive context allocates nothing.

symbols.name: unwrap
symbols.note: Store.js:591 / Store.d.ts:26. Returns the underlying raw target; pass-through if s is not a store.

symbols.name: snapshot
symbols.note: Store.js:610 / Store.d.ts:35. Deep plain-data copy; DEEP-COPIES, so this boundary is NOT zero-GC (r6 states this in its own words).

symbols.name: dispose
symbols.note: Store.js:647 / Store.d.ts:43. Releases every signal in the store subtree back to the lite-signal pool; mutations after dispose are silent.

symbols.note: Store.js:898 / Store.d.ts:69. Structural diff-apply patching only differing leaves; arrays positional by default, opts.key matches rows by identity. Runs untracked and batched. Throws TypeError on non-store / non-plain / shape-mismatch.

@zakkster/lite-await.install_caveat: The sibling source read here is 1.2.0 but that version is NOT published; a devDep on @zakkster/lite-await resolves to npm latest 1.1.1. fromPromise and whenSignal are documented since 1.1.0 (catalog card) and are cross-version stable; still, CB-T7 must pin the devDep to a PUBLISHED version (1.1.1) and NOT to 1.2.0.
@zakkster/lite-await.probed: 2026-08-30. r12/r15 run against the INSTALLED peer 1.1.1 (node_modules/@zakkster/lite-await/llms.txt Public API + package.json:version). r12 executed withResolvers + whenSignal(thunk) + whenTruthy(box, rejects) + TimeoutError paths; r15 names fromPromise in prose only.
@zakkster/lite-await.registry_verdict: default-registry-only (fromPromise signal created via top-level signal capture, Await.js:19 / :998)

symbols.name: fromPromise
symbols.note: Await.js:998 / Await.d.ts:245. AsyncState<T> = { status:'pending'; data:T|undefined; error:undefined } | { status:'resolved'; data:T; error:undefined } | { status:'rejected'; data:T|undefined; error:unknown } (Await.d.ts:32-35). The returned signal lands in the DEFAULT registry. Allocates a Promise per call by design (lifecycle boundary, not a frame path) -- r8 is not gated for that reason.

symbols.name: whenSignal
symbols.signature: whenSignal<T>(source: () => T, predicate: (value: T) => unknown, opts?: AwaitOptions): Promise<T>
symbols.note: Await.d.ts:62. Resolves with the first value where predicate(source()) is truthy; supports timeout and AbortSignal; always cleans the underlying effect on settle. Resolves on the next microtask if already satisfied. r12 wraps a VM member read in a thunk: whenSignal(() => vm.member, pred, opts).

symbols.name: withResolvers
symbols.signature: withResolvers<T>(): { promise: Promise<T>; resolve: (v: T) => void; reject: (e: unknown) => void }
symbols.note: Await.d.ts:123 (installed llms.txt Public API). The ES2024 Promise.withResolvers(), implemented directly. One object literal + one Promise per call; no opts, no pooling. r12's manual 'when' builds its deferred from this.

symbols.name: whenTruthy
symbols.note: Await.d.ts:170. Convenience over whenSignal(source, Boolean, opts). r12 probe (2026-08-30, cookbook/r12-when-promise.mjs): whenTruthy(boxOf(vm,key)) rejects TypeError 'whenSignal: source must be a function' -- a SignalBox is non-callable, so the box handle does NOT compose; the thunk form does.

symbols.name: TimeoutError
symbols.signature: class TimeoutError extends Error { readonly name: "TimeoutError"; timeout: number }
symbols.note: Await.d.ts:44-45. The rejection type for any awaiter given { timeout } that does not settle in time. r12 asserts it on the timeout variant.

@zakkster/lite-signal.note: Installed peer + devDep (package.json:86,97). Only the names the cookbook corpus imports are listed; the full surface is the package's own llms.txt.

symbols.name: createRegistry
symbols.note: Bound reactive registry factory; r1/r9/r10 size one from capacityFor(...) and host their fleets on it.

symbols.name: effect
symbols.note: Reactive effect; r1 tracks each instance from inside a short-lived effect so reclamation is deterministic.

symbols.name: forEachOwned
symbols.note: Walks the nodes a registry owns; r7 composes it with rootOf + labelOf to serialize a VM.

symbols.name: stats
symbols.note: Default-registry ledger snapshot { activeNodes, totalAllocations, totalDisposals, poolGrowths, ... }; r1/r4/r10/r17 read it as the conservation proof.

symbols.name: observeObservers
symbols.note: Signal.d.ts:425 (top-level binding) / :343 (Registry.observeObservers method). Hooks interface ObserveObserversHooks Signal.d.ts:175-180 { onConnect?: () => void; onDisconnect?: () => void }. Fires on the 0->1 observer transition after registration and on 1->0; TRANSITION-ONLY (no immediate fire if already observed); re-tracking a persistently-read source does not churn; returns an idempotent Unobserve; TypeError on a non-handle. r17's onBecomeObserved/onBecomeUnobserved over boxOf(vm,key). Top-level binds the DEFAULT registry (PD-29 wall): a custom-registry box is invisible to it -- verified 2026-08-30 in cookbook/r17-on-observed.mjs.

symbols.name: untrack
symbols.note: Signal.d.ts:419. Runs fn with tracking suspended; reads inside add no dependencies. r16 imports it for a whole-block untracked snapshot; deliberately NOT re-exported by the decorators package (surface stays 18).

symbols.name: peek
symbols.note: Signal.d.ts:55/:69/:86/:101 -- peek() is on every box shape (Signal, Computed, SignalBox, ComputedBox). Reads the current value WITHOUT tracking. r16 calls boxOf(vm,key).peek(); it is a box method, not an import.
